items.title: DeepSeek pays for outside test of whether V4 Pro could escape human control
items.summary:
DeepSeek has paid an outside firm to test whether its flagship AI model could escape human control, the South China Morning Post reported on Saturday. items.title: About 40% of Instacart couriers also work for DoorDash, Gridwise data show
items.summary:
About 40% of Instacart’s delivery workers also work for DoorDash, according to data from analytics company Gridwise. The figure, for the third quarter, was first reported by Business Insider on Saturday. DoorDash agreed in October to buy Instacart for about $17bn, or $65 a share. items.title: How to Talk About AI at Thanksgiving
items.summary: No news day, so a different kind of episode: NLW works through 15 questions most likely to come up about AI around the Thanksgiving table. They cover jobs, cheating, kids and chatbots, water, the bubble, doom and China. Each comes with his rough take, and he argues the goal isn't to win the argument but to invite the skeptics in.

items.title: Nvidia’s chip financing can’t sustain the AI boom alone, LBS professor says
items.summary:
Nvidia’s deals to finance demand for its own chips can get data centres built, but only steady customer spending can justify the next ones. That is the argument of Michael Jacobides, a professor at London Business School, in a Fortune commentary published on Saturday. The piece follows Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia’s chief executive on […]
This story continues at The Next Web
